vibe_rationale: Fifteen years of community surf culture in a World Surfing Reserve town, with a curated film programme that is narrower as a film-only event.
fit_notes: Adult surf community and surf travellers over a fortnight in peak season, with a clear active-lifestyle fit and no health brand precedent yet. A screening or programme partnership could reach the audience without heavy branding, and as an Australian brand High Ground would need a local partner.
